faq.q: What time should we board for the fireworks cruise?
faq.a: We recommend boarding at least 30 minutes before midnight – typically 23:30. This gives your skipper time to position the boat for the best view of the fireworks over Puerto Banús and the Marbella coastline. If you want a longer evening, many guests book a 4-hour charter starting around 22:00 to enjoy dinner or drinks on the water before the show.

faq.q: Which boats are available for NYE 2040?
faq.a: All our boats are available, but the most popular for groups are the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) from €749/2h. For a larger party, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, jet ski included) starts at €4,719/4h. Smaller groups often choose the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax). Contact us via WhatsApp for availability.

faq.q: What is included in the NYE charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees. The boat departs from Puerto Banús, and the skipper handles all navigation so you can focus on the fireworks.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks on board. Our standard package already includes a selection of drinks and snacks, but many guests add a catered dinner or champagne for the midnight toast. We recommend ordering a catering platter in advance – just let us know when booking.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on NYE?
faq.a: Your safety is our priority. If the forecast shows unsafe conditions, we will offer you a full refund or reschedule to another date. Typically, Marbella’s winter weather is mild (12–18°C), and the fireworks go ahead unless there is a storm. The skipper will make the final call on the day.

faq.q: How far in advance should we book?
faq.a: New Year's Eve is our busiest night. We recommend booking by early December to secure your preferred boat and time slot. Many boats are fully booked by mid-December, especially the larger ones like the Ferretti 94 or Mangusta 80. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability.

faq.q: Can we watch the fireworks from the boat and then go back to port?
faq.a: Absolutely. The skipper will position the boat for a clear view of the fireworks over Puerto Banús or the Marbella coast. After the show (around 00:15–00:30), the boat returns directly to the marina. If you want to extend the party, some guests book a 6- or 8-hour charter to continue celebrating into the early hours.

faq.q: Is there a minimum age or group size?
faq.a: There is no minimum age – children are welcome on board, and life jackets are provided for all sizes. The minimum group size depends on the boat: the Dubhe (5 pax) works for couples or small families, while the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) suits larger groups. All boats have a maximum capacity that must not be exceeded for safety.

data.body_html:
Ringing in 2040 from the water is the ultimate Marbella move. Imagine the midnight sky erupting over Puerto Banús while you float on a private boat with your closest friends, a glass of cava in hand, and zero crowds. Our New Year's Eve boat rental Marbella 2040 fireworks cruises depart from Puerto Banús with a licensed skipper, drinks, and prime views of the show. No queuing, no elbow-to-elbow pavement – just the sea, the stars, and the fireworks.

Why watch the NYE fireworks from a boat?

Marbella's fireworks are launched over the coast near Puerto Banús, and the best seat in the house is on the water. From a boat, you get an unobstructed 360-degree view of the display reflecting off the sea. The sound hits you a beat later, amplified by the water, making the experience more immersive than any beach or balcony. Plus, you control the vibe – play your own playlist, bring your own food, and stay as long as you like.

Our fleet for NYE 2040

We have boats for every group size. All depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Here's the lineup:

  • Tier A (from €749/2h): Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – perfect for couples or small groups wanting a stylish evening.
  • Tier B (from €4,719/4h): Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – the showstopper, with a free jet ski included for daytime fun.
  • Other boats (pricing on request): Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), and more. Contact us via WhatsApp for rates.
  • Smaller options: Dubhe (8m, 5 pax), Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax), Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – ideal for intimate celebrations.

All boats are fully equipped with safety gear, heating (if needed), and a sound system. The skipper handles navigation so you can focus on the countdown.

What's included in your NYE charter

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden extras. You are welcome to bring your own food and drinks – many guests order a catered platter or champagne for the midnight toast. Just let us know when you book.

Timeline for the perfect NYE on the water

Most guests board around 23:00 to settle in, enjoy a drink, and watch the marina come alive. The skipper will position the boat for the best view of the fireworks, which typically launch at midnight and last 10–15 minutes. After the show, the boat returns to Puerto Banús by 00:30. If you want a longer evening, book a 4- or 6-hour charter starting at 22:00 – you can cruise along the coast, anchor for dinner, and still catch the fireworks.

Book early – NYE slots sell out fast

New Year's Eve is our busiest night of the year. Boats like the Ferretti 94, Mangusta 80, and Astondoa 40 are often fully booked by mid-December. To secure your preferred boat and time slot, we recommend booking by early December. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and custom durations. A 50% deposit holds your booking, with the balance due 7 days before departure.
